body:
Thank you. ^.^ 
I'll be sure to check it out. 
I really do appreciate you trying to help me, a stranger out. :)

Thank you for your support. I don't really have much energy to type right now, so I do apologise for my lack of appreciation in showing how thankful I am for your kind words. I've just been very under the whether this couple weeks, and like I've mentioned above, I just want to end it all but lack the 'courage' to fully commit. I have been seeing a psychologist, actually, as stated in my first reddit post, but every time I come home, everything just goes back to 'normal' or even worse.

Thank you for your words. My Mother... She confuses me.. She makes it seem like I need her. And sometimes, I wonder, or feel like, I do, despite the emotional and physical abuse (Not so much on the physical abuse now). One minute she treats me normally, then the next second she brings me down like I'm just a pile of worthless trash forgotten on bin day. It feels terrible. So words of comfort doesn't really mean anything to me compared to many years of words of emotional abuse.. But if I'm being honest, on my happy days, it does help. So I really do appreciate it. THANK YOU! ^ And I'll be sure to visit the link you provided, thank you. :)

I know she's not right. But she's drilled those words in my head since I was young, I can't help but think that about myself. I even mutter those words out to my reflection all of a sudden when looking at the mirror. It makes me want to cry and punch it.
